lines.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.
Don't worry. Next, an era is coming when entertainment will rain straight down from the sky.
It has been so long that I feel nervous.
You will be fine. You are truly radiant.

words.gram: 本当 (truth) + に functioning as an adverb.

lines.trans: There is no higher compliment than that.
Together with you, let's take everyone into a brand-new world.
All right, camera! Let's roll the take.
Camera is rolling.
Right now, Kaoru Kuroki and I are beginning a passionate performance.
I intend to show all of you the very moment a miracle happens.
No matter what happens next, please do not close your eyes.
Are you ready? Here we go—ready, action!

meanings.note: Attached to surnames, given names, or company names to show everyday respect; never used for oneself.

examples.text: 村西さん、新会社のビル、あそこで決めていいんですね？全額投資しますよ。
examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: 村西さん、新会社のビル、あそこで決めていいんですね？全額投資しますよ。
examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb; potential form 決められる means 'can decide'.

examples.text: まだ何も決めていません。
今決められないなら、後で考えましょう。
examples.trans: If you can't decide now, let's think about it later.

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。
俺のせいです。保釈金を全額用意できなかったんで。
examples.trans: It is my fault, because I couldn't raise the full bail amount in time.

examples.text: 村西さん、新会社のビル、あそこで決めていいんですね？全額投資しますよ。
examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.

examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Core everyday reassurance or check covering safety, health, and reliability.

examples.text: 心配しないで、大丈夫だよ。
examples.trans: Do not worry, it is fine.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Used with の to modify the following noun (次のお二人様, 次の駅).

examples.trans: I get off at the next station.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: ただ販売するには、必ずヒットするってことを示さないと。
examples.trans: Still, to get stores to carry it, we must prove it will definitely be a hit.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Noun.

examples.text: 今日は空がとても青いですね。
examples.trans: The sky is very blue today, isn't it?
Birds are flying in the sky.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: 大丈夫です。次は必ず空からエロが降ってくる時代が来ます。
examples.trans: Don't worry. Next, an era is coming when entertainment will rain straight down from the sky.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Noun.

examples.text: 時代が変わりましたね。

meanings.note: Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.
Second-person pronoun used by superiors, in songs/books, or between close friends.

examples.text: 君の意見はどうですか。
君ならきっとできるよ。

meanings.note: I-adjective describing beauty.

examples.trans: Mama, you're looking beautiful today too.
There is no higher compliment than that.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Polite way to address a group of people.

examples.text: 皆さんにお知らせがあります。
examples.trans: I have an announcement for everyone.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Modifies nouns directly, as in 新しい店 ('new store') and 新しい仕事 ('new job').

examples.text: 新しい仕事が始まりました。
新しい靴を買いました。

meanings.note: Used for the physical world or a specific sphere/industry (この世界).

examples.text: この世界に入る覚悟はあるか。
examples.trans: Are you prepared to enter this world?

meanings.note: Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.
Prompts someone into action or shoos them along.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').
Standard gender-neutral 'I' in polite and business Japanese.

examples.text: 今から私は黒木香さんと熱いファイトをします。
examples.trans: Right now, Kaoru Kuroki and I are beginning a passionate performance.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'miracle'.

meanings.en: to happen; to occur; to wake up
meanings.note: Ichidan verb.

examples.trans: I wake up at seven every morning.

meanings.note: Noun.

examples.text: その瞬間を待っていた。
examples.trans: I was waiting for that moment.

meanings.note: Prefixed to native Japanese words (お店, お二人, お持ち帰り) to add politeness.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Humble counterpart of いる, commonly used in ～ております.

meanings.en: what kind of; what sort of
meanings.note: Interrogative prenominal modifier.

examples.text: どんな音楽を聴きますか。
examples.trans: What kind of music do you listen to?

examples.text: どんな仕事をしているんですか。
examples.trans: What kind of work do you do?

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Between の and な (あなたのような人), describes someone or something 'like ...'.

examples.text: 春のような暖かい日です。
examples.trans: It is a warm day like spring.

examples.text: あなたのような人を探していました。
examples.trans: I was looking for someone like you.

meanings.note: Attaches to numbers/counters (二人とも, 三人とも) to mean 'both/all of them'.
Noun.
Ichidan verb, used for eyes, books, doors, etc.
Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Formal/polite transition; contracts to それじゃ or じゃあ in casual speech.

examples.text: それでは始めましょう。

meanings.note: Humble counterpart of 行く and 来る.

examples.text: それでは参りましょう。

meanings.note: Cue word used before starting a race or filming.
Film/theater cue or general noun from English 'action'.

examples.text: 次のアクションを起こす。

meanings.note: Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。
